name: SYS

inventory.method: files tracked at the pin under iris_vector_graph, iris_src, api, sql, src, deploy, docker, examples, scripts, config plus docker-compose.yml, pyproject.toml, uv.lock (browser_static counted once as a vendored bundle); AST for Python (public functions, public methods of public classes and the engine's SubEngine facades, FastAPI/Starlette routes and include_router mounts, strawberry fields, click commands), regex for ObjectScript (ClassMethod/Method/Query with SqlProc/SqlName/Private/Language=python flags, %CSP.REST UrlMap routes, %SYS.Task.Definition subclasses and %SYS.Task creators), SQL (CREATE PROCEDURE/FUNCTION/TABLE/INDEX), deploy files (compose services, Dockerfiles, shell installers, CPF merges, pyproject console scripts, __main__ blocks). Ownership: RULES in inventory.py, a transcription of every module's Scope line (ontology/NN-*.md, 'Scope:'), with method-level splits for shared files.

reconciliation.summary: 180 of 435 code files and 899 of 3284 entry points belong to no module's Scope line. 153 of the files are scripts/ (developer tooling, benchmarks, TCK, coverage), 19 examples/, 4 iris_src/dev classes, 3 package __init__ files and config/mcp-graph.toml. The unowned entry points that matter are product writers and deployment/interface paths listed below; the rest are tooling.

unowned_product_entry_points.name: IRISGraphEngine.import_graph_ndjson
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: bulk writer of nodes, edges and temporal edges; reachable over HTTP through POST /admin/load (cypher_api.py:628-645, module 16's route, whose body is not stated) and the SDK/CLI `ivg load`; module 18's Scope excludes it explicitly and no other Scope names it

unowned_product_entry_points.name: IRISGraphEngine.export_graph_ndjson
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: reachable over HTTP through GET /admin/export (cypher_api.py:646-666); excluded by 18's Scope

unowned_product_entry_points.name: IRISGraphEngine.import_rdf
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: bulk writer; excluded by 18's Scope, not named by 15 (RDF export only)

unowned_product_entry_points.name: IRISGraphEngine.materialize_inference / retract_inference
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: write and delete inferred edges ({"inferred":true}) and their ^KG adjacency; ledger-checked (_ledger_check, schema.py:2977) but in no module's Scope (01 owns setup in schema.py, 04 sync/rebuild, 06 the registry half, 15 only reification)

unowned_product_entry_points.name: IRISGraphEngine.get_labels, get_relationship_types, get_node_count, get_edge_count, get_label_distribution, get_property_keys, node_exists, get_schema_visualization
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: schema-introspection reads with graph-scope semantics (HD-0201) owned by no module

unowned_product_entry_points.name: setup_tables (module function)
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: public DDL helper outside 01's named set (initialize_schema and its helpers)

unowned_product_entry_points.name: IRISGraphEngine.from_connect / from_wrapper / capabilities
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: the documented ways to obtain an engine; 02 owns only engine.py's graph-scoping parts and 03 its write facade; 17's statements cover connections and the capability matrix (OPS-D1, HD-1703) without naming these

unowned_product_entry_points.name: IRISGraphEngine.drop_graph
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: excluded from 03's Scope and not in 12's line range (nodes_edges.py:1473-1560); behaviourally erase_graph, so a Scope omission only

unowned_product_entry_points.name: RevisionInfo.from_wire, RedactionReceipt.from_wire / revisions_touched
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: the ledger client's wire decoders (gate 3.5-decoders) fall outside 11's and 13's method lists

unowned_product_entry_points.name: iris_vector_graph/__init__.py (package exports), _engine/__init__.py, stores/__init__.py
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: the exported names define the public API (HD-0705) but no Scope owns the export list

unowned_product_entry_points.name: iris_src/dev/*.cls (Graph.KG.BenchFormat, Graph.KG.Benchmark, User.Exec, iris.vector.graph.GraphOperators)
unowned_product_entry_points.why_it_matters: not deployed by initialize_schema (class_deploy reads iris_src/src only: _engine/class_deploy.py:55); GraphOperators duplicates kg_TXT/kg_KNN_VEC/kg_GRAPH_PATH/kg_RRF_FUSE as an older generation; low risk unless loaded by hand

unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.name: scripts/mcp/ivg_mcp_server.py + config/mcp-graph.toml
unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.why_it_matters: a stdio MCP server exposing Cypher and graph-loading tools, connecting as IRIS_USER default 'SuperUser' with password default 'SYS' (ivg_mcp_server.py:15-19); an interface entry point no Scope names (16 covers the %AI MCP classes only)

unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.name: pyproject.toml [project.scripts] run-tests -> scripts.test:main, networkx-loader -> scripts.ingest.networkx_loader:main
unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.why_it_matters: installed console scripts; scripts/test.py does not exist at the pin and scripts/ is not in the wheel (finding F-C1701, module 17)

unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.name: scripts/deploy_production.py, scripts/deploy_objectscript.py, scripts/deploy_graph_tvfs.py, scripts/setup_iris.py, scripts/setup_security.sql, scripts/install-embedded-deps.sh
unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.why_it_matters: operator-facing install paths; HD-0103 treats the legacy deployer as reachable and 01/08 cite deploy_production.py in statements, but no Scope line owns these files; setup_security.sql is the SQL half of ADMIN_GUIDE section 3's least-privilege roles

unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.name: scripts/migrations/migrate_to_nodepk.py, scripts/backfill_temporal_edges.py, scripts/sweep_bare_nodes_interim.py, scripts/ingest/load_umls_bridges.py, scripts/load_drkg.py, scripts/load_demo_data.py
unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.why_it_matters: operator-run writers of product tables outside every module (sweep_bare_nodes_interim is the interim tool for erase_bare_nodes, 05)

unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.name: examples/domains/biomedical/{types,loaders}.py
unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.why_it_matters: imported by the sample API (api/gql/schema.py:78-85); this inventory assigns resolver.py to 16 (cited by API-B6.7) but the loaders and types are equally part of the sample API's runtime

unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.name: iris_vector_graph/browser_static/**
unowned_deployment_and_interface_paths.why_it_matters: vendored Neo4j Browser bundle served by GET /browser (cypher_api.py:73-75); excluded from the wheel (pyproject.toml wheel exclude) and mounted only when the directory exists (cypher_api.py:73-75), so a wheel install serves no browser; owned by no Scope
